text:
reena: FYI i kicked off a regional recompute for late-us-west events to validate quota gating + routing fallback. saw unexpected queue aging for small tenants during a 4x late spike.

otto: can you share the run args? which routing policy?

reena: command: ./tools/recompute --region=us-west --policy=quota-gate-fallback --parallel=600 --late-spike=4x --seed=11

ingest-bot: summary: processed=820k, avg_wait_all=12s, p95_small=380s, preempted=120

claire: ugh p95_small 380s is bad. do we have traces showing why they wait? is it preemption churn or long lead queue?

reena: traces point to two things: 1) quota-gate pushes jobs to a deferred queue when global slots exhausted 2) fallback routing to lower-cost zone adds routing delay and some jobs get preempted on resume.

kevin: fallback routing is intended to preserve throughput, but we didn't account for small-tenant sensitivity. maybe we should add a "prefer-local-for-small" soft rule so small tenants skip cross-zone fallback.

claire: that will reduce global utilization efficiency. can we instead make fallback synchronous but expedite small-tenant resumes (shorter backoff)?

otto: proposal: add small-tenant resume fastpath: if tenant_quota<=4 then resume_backoff=5s else 30s. Also emit telemetry: preempted_by_zone, resume_latency_by_quota.

reena: i like the fastpath idea. ran a quick sim: p95_small dropped ~14% with minimal impact to throughput. config snippet: preempt_resume_backoff: { small: 5, default: 30 }

kevin: console UX: we need to surface "resume aggressiveness" with a simple toggle and an advanced note about fairness. default OFF so we can stage.

claire: telemetry work: add two tiles to recompute dashboard: 1) stacked bar preempted_by_zone per hour 2) heatmap resume_latency by quota cohort. Also add alert: p95_small > baseline*1.2 for 15m.

ingest-bot: metric names suggested: recompute.preempted_by_zone, recompute.resume_latency_seconds, recompute.p95_by_quota

reena: action items: reena -> hook fastpath in scheduler and run staging sim (owner: reena); kevin -> console toggle mock (owner: kevin); claire -> dashboard + alert (owner: claire).

otto: i'll add unit tests for backoff path and a small e2e in staging. schedule sims for Tue 03:00 UTC.

reena: booked staging sim Tue 03:00 UTC. will post results here after run. :thumbsup:
